source: Comm-change reporting points populated from maintainer visual inspection of the printed IAA CVFR chart symbology ('נקודת מעבר קשר' — comm-transfer point legend), 2026-05-31. Frequencies (from/to) are deferred to a later pass; each point is flagged commChange:true with verified:false until a frequency pair and/or a published-document citation is added. Earlier desk-research sources (Israel eAIP 2025-10-02, PAMAT edition 1/24) did not yield OCR-extractable per-point data — see _NOTE.
_definition: Each entry marks a CVFR reporting point where pilots are expected to switch ATC frequencies because the point sits on (or at) a sector / CTR / TMA boundary. The chart annotation may be on the boundary line itself rather than directly at the point — the dataset records the *point of change*, not the chart-text position.
_NOTE: Reporting-type (חובה / דרישה — mandatory vs. on-request) is NOT comm-change and is tracked separately (PR #405). The points below come from maintainer inspection of the printed IAA CVFR chart's 'נקודת מעבר קשר' symbology, which supersedes the earlier citation bar that left this file empty. They carry verified:false because frequencies and a public-document citation are not yet attached; promote to verified:true per-point once from/to and a citable source are added. Points are matched to nav-waypoints.json by 5-letter ICAO `name` only — never by Hebrew text.

Attach a public-document citation (IAA AIP supplement / PAMAT chapter B-03 page) per point where one exists, in the per-entry `source` field.
Reporting-type data (mandatory / on-request) is tracked separately on the feat/reporting-required branch (PR #405) — DO NOT conflate the two datasets.
